item.title: Trump says Obama "wouldn't understand" White House renovations
item.description: "I would try and explain that to a guy like Obama, but he wouldn't understand," President Trump said at a rally in Mississippi.

item.title: 8-month Iran war looms large over Israeli election
item.description: Israeli voters are choosing their next government, with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu insisting only he can finish the job started eight months ago in Iran.

item.title: DOJ asks Washington to set aside ballots from 400 alleged noncitizens
item.description: Federal prosecutors said they sent a letter to the Washington secretary of state with a list of 400 people they claimed are not U.S. citizens.

item.title: Florida mom left kids home alone while on trip to Vegas, deputies say
item.description: The investigation began when a child called 911 reporting a dumbbell fell on her brother's head, deputies say.

item.title: Israeli police arrest man with knife near left-wing leader
item.description: A man with a knife was arrested at an Israeli election event for left-wing leader Yair Golan as Israelis vote in a crucial election.

item.title: High airfares are weighing on Thanksgiving travel plans this year
item.description: Average fares for the Thanksgiving holiday were up 31% in August from a year ago, according to aviation pricing data.

item.title: John Thune's balancing act: Inside his push to save the GOP majority
item.description: Senate Majority Leader John Thune has tried to balance passing the president's agenda and preserving the independence of the Senate. The midterms are his biggest test yet.

item.title: Former Bee & Co. employee recalls high-pressure sales tactics
item.description: Since a CBS California Investigates report first aired in August, Bee & Co. stores at Westfield Topanga in Canoga Park and Del Amo Fashion Center in Torrance have closed their doors permanently.

item.title: New details revealed in "People's Court" cold case murder arrest
item.description: Michelle Parker went missing on the same day that an episode of "The People's Court" about a dispute between herself and Dale Smith Jr. aired.

item.title: Inside John Thune's quiet effort to keep GOP's Senate majority
item.description: Senate Majority Leader John Thune is fighting to maintain Republican control of the U.S. Senate. CBS News' Kaia Hubbard spoke with Thune about his leadership and behind-the-scenes work.

item.title: Israel's election outcomes not likely to change Iran or Gaza wars, former ambassador says
item.description: Israelis are voting in their first national election since the Oct. 7, 2023, attacks. Former Israeli ambassador to U.S. Michael Oren weighs in on Israel's current political landscape.

item.title: Trump reacts to Obama's "Cheesecake Factory" comment, heads to Texas to back Paxton
item.description: President Trump is campaigning for Texas gubernatorial candidate Ken Paxton. CBS News' Ed O'Keefe has more analysis.

item.title: Jackson pulls ahead of Collins in Senate race, new Maine poll shows
item.description: President Trump continues supporting Republican candidates with campaign stops across the U.S. Meanwhile, musician John Legend campaigned for Democrats in Ohio, and a new Maine poll shows Democrat Troy Jackson leading Republican Susan Collins in a tight Senate race. CBS News' Weijia Jiang and Portland Press Herald politics reporter Billy Kobin have more.

item.title: Convicted murderer escapes prison through fence, steals truck
item.description: Authorities say a man serving a life sentence for murder escaped from a prison in northwest Tennessee, stole a truck and remained at large early Tuesday.

item.title: New charges filed ex-FBI officials related to Hunter Biden probe
item.description: The unsigned and unsworn superseding complaint comes just hours before the defendants are due to appear in federal court in Washington, D.C. for a preliminary hearing.

item.title: Trump's oil and gas stocks gained millions in value amid Iran war, according to Democrats' report
item.description: The value of President Trump's personal oil and gas stock holdings has nearly doubled since his war with Iran began, according to a report by Democrats on the Congressional Joint Economic Committee. CBS News' Olivia Rinaldi has more.

item.title: Comey says he's "still innocent" after Trump administration attempts third round of charges
item.description: Former FBI Director James Comey once again faces potential charges from the Trump administration's Department of Justice, which is now seeking charges for allegedly leaking classified information. Defense attorney and former federal prosecutor Scott Fredericksen comments on the case's legality.

item.title: Greenhouse gas levels set records again in 2025, U.N. says
item.description: Greenhouse gas concentrations in the atmosphere rose to record highs in 2025, locking in climate​ impacts that will persist for centuries, the U.N. says.

item.title: U.K. charges 2 men linked to alleged terror plot against air base
item.description: Two men arrested in connection with the alleged Iran-linked terror plot targeting RAF Fairford in England have been charged with national security offenses.

item.title: In Trump's pardon economy, victims lost out on $119M in restitution
item.description: Small businesses and retirees are left empty-handed as fraudsters, some represented by Trump allies, win clemency.

item.title: TikTok parent ByteDance's founder is China's richest person again
item.description: The founder of Tiktok parent ByteDance, Zhang Yiming, reclaimed the top spot on a list of China's richest people, driven by his company's push into AI.

item.title: Hospital beds for the nation's sickest kids are disappearing
item.description: Hospitals nationwide are cutting intensive services for kids in critical care. Many cite too few patients, staffing shortages, and money problems.

item.title: Jay-Z to headline 2027 Super Bowl halftime show
item.description: The NFL, Apple Music and Roc Nation announced Monday night that Jay-Z will be the featured performer for the halftime festivities on Feb. 14 at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California.

item.title: Dollar General overcharged people at checkout for years, FTC says
item.description: The discount retailer routinely charges customers more at checkout than the prices it displays on shelves, price tags and ads, according to federal and state authorities.

item.title: Is the Federal Reserve likely to raise interest rates this week?
item.description: Fed officials will unveil their latest interest rate move this week, following the September rate hike, the first in three years.

item.title: Microsoft offers buyouts to 60,000 workers as it invests more in AI
item.description: Roughly a quarter of Microsoft's workforce will be eligible for a "voluntary exit offer" as the company tries to shed workers.

item.title: Consumers face scarier Halloween costs this year. Here's why.
item.description: Americans are forecast to spend a record $13.5 billion on Halloween this year, with the average consumer shelling out hundreds of dollars.

item.title: Trump's oil and gas stocks gained millions during Iran war
item.description: A report from congressional Democrats found the president purchased millions in oil and gas stocks during the war.

item.title: Dictionary.com announces its 2026 Word of the Year
item.description: The viral social media trend "maxxing" has earned its stripes as Dictionary.com's 2026 Word of the Year.

item.title: 2026 midterm election races to watch
item.description: CBS News has identified 10 key Senate and 42 House races that will likely decide the majority — all of which can change during the midterm campaign.
